subject.title: fix(openai): align auth availability with effective routes

question: Should provider route-resolution and harness transport-compatibility facts become a supported permanent Plugin SDK contract in this PR?
rationale: The implementation fixes a real routing bug but also creates an external API promise and changes implicit OpenAI runtime behavior; automated tests cannot authorize that long-term compatibility direction.

options.title: Approve the public contract
options.body: Keep the SDK route contract and require green exact-head compatibility, upgrade, and hosted prepare proof before merge.

options.title: Internalize route facts
options.body: Retain the OpenAI correction behind bundled internal surfaces and review a narrower external plugin API separately.

options.title: Pause the migration
options.body: Replace this broad branch with a smaller compatibility-preserving fix if the permanent SDK promise is not justified.

recommendation.title: Approve the public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the SDK route contract and require green exact-head compatibility, upgrade, and hosted prepare proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: His current-main merged history owns the combined OpenAI/Codex routing, authentication, and Plugin SDK surfaces whose permanent contract is being decided.
